        idx = json.load(f)
    shard_to_keys = defaultdict(list)
    for key, shard in idx["weight_map"].items():
        shard_to_keys[shard].append(key)
    return idx["weight_map"], shard_to_keys

def classify_layer(name):
    if name.startswith("vision_backbone."):
        return "vision"
    elif name.startswith("projector."):
        return "projector"
    elif name == "language_model.lm_head.weight":
        return "head"
    elif name == "language_model.model.embed_tokens.weight":
        return "embedding"
    elif name.startswith("language_model.model.norm."):
        return "llm_final_norm"
    elif name.startswith("language_model.model.layers."):
        return "llm"
    else:
        return "other"

def get_llm_layer_idx(name):
    if name.startswith("language_model.model.layers."):
        parts = name.split(".")
        return int(parts[3])
    return -1

    with safe_open(trained_path, framework="pt", device="cpu") as t_f:
        for key in keys_in_shard:
            if key not in all_keys:
                continue
            t_tensor = t_f.get_tensor(key).float()
            
            # Load corresponding untrained tensor
            u_shard = untrained_map[key]
            u_path = os.path.join(UNTRAINED_DIR, u_shard)
            with safe_open(u_path, framework="pt", device="cpu") as u_f:
                u_tensor = u_f.get_tensor(key).float()
            
            diff = t_tensor - u_tensor
            frob_norm = torch.norm(diff).item()
            u_norm = torch.norm(u_tensor).item()
            t_norm = torch.norm(t_tensor).item()
            
            if u_norm > 1e-10:
                rel_change = frob_norm / u_norm
            else:
                rel_change = float('inf') if frob_norm > 1e-10 else 0.0
            
            t_flat = t_tensor.flatten()
            u_flat = u_tensor.flatten()
            cos_sim = torch.nn.functional.cosine_similarity(
                t_flat.unsqueeze(0), u_flat.unsqueeze(0)
            ).item()
            
            group = classify_layer(key)
